_notes.post_market_time_pkt: scheduler fires after this PKT time on trading weekdays; daemon sleeps until it, cron entries use the UTC equivalent
_notes.universe: pilot25 = the 25-symbol shadow universe; 'all' = every symbol in OhlcvBar (~909); a comma list is also accepted via --symbols
_notes.holidays: explicit non-trading weekday dates (ISO) — provider absence of a new session is otherwise treated as 'eod not published yet' and retried
_notes.retry: if the provider has not published the session's final EOD data, run marks the attempt retryable (exit 2, status FAILED 'eod_not_published_or_provider_unavailable'); the daemon retries every retry_interval_min for up to max_retry_window_min
_notes.stages.glm: disabled by default — GLM-4.6 generation needs z-ai SDK credentials (host only); enable via --glm or here
_notes.overlap_days: re-fetch window used to reconcile provider bars against stored rows; conflicts are quarantined, never overwritten
